notes: Public numeric performance claims must reference an artifact with these fields, raw load-tool output entries, and repeated grouped variance, or explicitly state that the number is a local snapshot or tuning example, not a product claim. The telemetry field records under-load peak RSS, aggregate CPU%, and a per-process CPU/RSS time series sampled across the root server and any forked worker processes (best-effort; null summaries or empty point lists when the platform does not expose process telemetry). The reload/drain-under-load profile (benchmarks/drain_profile.py) adds an optional per-sample drain block recording the four drain-contract metrics: in-flight request completion (inflight_completed / inflight_expected), brand-new-connection disconnect_rate and silent drop_rate, drain_duration_s (bounded by shutdown_timeout), and orphan_workers; clean_drain is true only when every in-flight request completed, no connection was silently dropped, the process exited within the timeout, and no worker was orphaned.
